caveats: Labels are agent-authored and not human reviewed.

Costs are estimates from config/pricing.json (version 2026-09-06-openrouter), not billing records.
Model arms ran at reasoning effort medium; production uses high.
The single arm saw the first eight seeded sources by id (no retrieval on this text-only corpus).
The multi arm made 1 tool call and cited sources in 0 of 120 cases; its routing was not tool-grounded in this run.
